description: This file defines the React component 'MenuPaneSelector' which renders different account menu panes based on the current menu state. It manages user interactions within the account menu, switching between sign-in, registration, password confirmation, and general menu views.

classes.description: TypeScript type defining properties expected by the MenuPaneSelector component, including view state and callback functions.
